daily_picture.title: Картина дня
daily_picture.body: В выпуске «Технологии» собрано 4 ключевых событий из 4 источников. Основные темы сопоставлены между независимыми публикациями, а важность выражена единым редакционным рейтингом. Материалы собраны из тестовых источников и предназначены для проверки интерфейса.

articles.title: Public agencies introduce independent audits for AI systems
articles.normalized_title: public agencies introduce independent audits for ai systems
articles.excerpt: Government departments will publish risk reports and commission external audits before high-impact automated systems can be deployed.

articles.title: A small team releases an open distributed database
articles.normalized_title: a small team releases an open distributed database
articles.excerpt: The project focuses on predictable replication and ships with a simulator for testing network partitions on a developer laptop.

articles.title: A practical guide to structured concurrency in Python
articles.normalized_title: a practical guide to structured concurrency in python
articles.excerpt: The tutorial compares task groups with manually managed tasks and demonstrates cancellation, timeout and cleanup patterns.

articles.title: A compact model for forecasting local heat waves
articles.normalized_title: a compact model for forecasting local heat waves
articles.excerpt: Researchers describe a smaller forecasting model designed for municipalities with limited computing capacity and sparse sensor coverage.
